style: Energetic, curious popular-science host. Brisk, upbeat pace, about 3.3 syllables per second. Clear standard Mandarin, a light smile in the voice, lift slightly on questions, short pauses only at full stops.

lines.text: 伸出手，看看你的指甲盖。就在这一秒，大约650亿个来自太阳的粒子，正从它中间穿过。你毫无感觉。它们叫中微子。
